errors.unreachable: We couldn't reach ChainTrack just now. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

unexpectedRef.$template: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, quote reference {id}.

errors.badAnswer: ChainTrack answered in a way this page doesn't understand. Reload the page.

shell.switchNote: Opens that organisation's address; you stay signed in.

list.noMatch: Nothing matches. Try another search or filter.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.sub: Everything that happened to your lots, handovers, certificates and flags. Open one to go to it.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.sub: Your account and how you sign in and sign records.
profile.name: Full name
profile.passwordHelp: Use 8 to 72 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
profile.pinHelpSet: Your PIN is set. You enter it whenever you sign a record.
profile.pinHelpUnset: Set a 6-digit PIN. You'll need it to sign passports, handovers and certificates.
profile.twoFactorHelp: Ask for a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
profile.scanQr: Scan this with your authenticator app, or type the key below.
profile.turnOffHelp: Enter a current code from your app to turn it off.
profile.recoveryBody: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
profile.newRecoveryHelp: Enter a current code from your app. Your old recovery codes stop working.

users.title: Users
users.subOrg: People who can act for your organisation.
users.notEmailed: E-mail is off, so nothing was sent. Share this link with them (development only):
users.notAllowedBody: Only organisation admins and the platform admin can open this page.

invite.title: Join an organisation
invite.sub: You've been invited to act for an organisation on ChainTrack.
invite.name: Full name
invite.nameHelp: Leave empty if you already have a ChainTrack account.
invite.passwordHelp: New account: use 8 to 72 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol. Existing account: enter your current password.
invite.signInAt: Sign in at your organisation's address

incoming.title: Incoming handovers
incoming.sub: Lots on their way to you that need your answer
incoming.empty: Nothing on its way to you.

passports.title: Passports you hold
passports.empty: You don't hold any active passports.

capacity.title: Facility capacity
capacity.empty: No facilities yet. Register a facility before issuing passports.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.noneTitle: You don't belong to an organisation yet.
workspaces.noneBody: Ask your organisation's admin for an invitation, or create your organisation's account.

scan.title: Scan a passport
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR label on the bag, box or document.
scan.noCamera: The camera isn't available here. Type the lot code instead.
scan.codeHint: Printed under the QR code, e.g. ACME-2026-0412

signing.title: Sign with your PIN
signing.label: 6-digit signing PIN
signing.help: This signature is yours alone; your PIN is checked once for this action.
signing.noPinTitle: You don't have a signing PIN yet
signing.noPinBody: Set a 6-digit PIN in your profile, then come back to sign this record.
signing.setPin: Set a PIN in your profile

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.empty: No facilities yet. A facility is where your goods originate or are handled: a plot, a site, a station or a warehouse. Register one before issuing passports.
facilities.suspendBody: It can't issue passports while suspended. Lots already issued here keep their records.
facilities.pendingNote: The platform checks the licence and location before this facility can issue passports.
facilities.expiredNote: The licence has ended. Upload the renewed licence to keep issuing from here.

detail.deleteBody: The facility is removed from your list. Passports already issued here keep their records and their journey.

new.title: Register facility
new.sub: A place where your goods originate or are handled. You need one before issuing passports.
new.name: Facility name
new.nameHelp: What your team calls it, like Plot 14 · Kigoma Hill.
new.capacityHelp: The most that may originate here in one period. Capacity is checked every time a passport is issued from here.
new.unitHelp: The unit your commodity template uses, like kg.

hint.pin: Tap the map where the facility is.
hint.area: Tap the map to add corners, at least 3. The shape closes itself.

new.search: Find a place on the map
new.searchHelp: Search for a village, town or landmark, then choose a result to centre the map. You can still adjust the pin or boundary.
new.searchNone: No places found. Try a different name or place the pin on the map.
new.mapLabel: Map: tap to place the facility
new.gpsHelp: Your browser asks for permission. Put yourself inside the facility.
new.gpsFail: We couldn't get your position. Allow location access and try again, or tap the map.
new.licenceDocHelp: A PDF or clear photo of the licence. You can add it later from the facility.
new.approvalNote: The platform approves each facility before it can issue passports. Capacity is checked every time a passport is issued from here.
new.licenceFailed: The facility is saved, but the licence didn't upload. Upload it from the facility.

issue.title: Issue passport
issue.templateHelp: Sets the unit, the stages your lot moves through and the evidence each stage needs.
issue.templateEmpty: No templates yet. A platform admin creates the commodity templates.
issue.facilityEmpty: No facilities yet. Register a farm plot, site or warehouse first.
issue.evidenceHelp: The template's first stage asks for a valid certificate of each of these, attached to this facility.
issue.evidenceNone: This template asks for no evidence before issuing.

evidenceMissing.$template: Missing: {keys}. Ask a certifier to issue these certificates for this facility, then issue the passport.

issue.meaning: Your signature records this harvest on ChainTrack. It can't be edited afterwards; mistakes are corrected with a new, linked record.
issue.blockedReason: Continue is blocked until the quantity fits.
issue.labelsNote: Print one label per bag or crate. Labels print at 50 × 30 mm on standard thermal printers.

handover.title: Hand over a lot
handover.pickHint: Scan the QR label on the bags, or choose a lot you hold.
handover.pickEmpty: You don't hold any active passports. Issue a passport before handing a lot over.
handover.canHandOver: You hold this lot and nothing is pending on it. It can be handed over.
handover.notHolder: Another organisation holds this lot. Only its holder can hand it over.
handover.openFlag: A flag is open on this lot. It can't be handed over until the flag is resolved.
handover.openHandover: A handover of this lot is still waiting for the receiver. Cancel it or wait for their answer.

partial.$template: Sending less keeps the rest ({rest}) on this passport; the part you send gets its own lot code.

handover.stageHelp: Only stages of this product that allow a handover.
handover.noStages: This product's template has no stage that allows a handover. Ask your platform admin to add one.
handover.locationFailed: Your location isn't available. You can send without it.

photosHelp.$template: Up to {max}: bags, seal, the truck.

handover.stayHolder: You stay the holder until the receiver signs. Unanswered handovers expire in 7 days.
handover.noteHelp: A place and how the goods were handed over, like Nyamagabe depot, sealed bags on truck KTB-409.
handover.receiverEmpty: No verified organisations match that name.
handover.receiverEmptyAll: No other verified organisations yet. A receiver must be verified by the platform before it can receive lots.

meaning.$template: You confirm these goods left your custody. {receiver} must inspect and sign before the handover is complete.

handover.cancelNote: If they reject the handover, you're notified and the lot stays with you while the flag is open.
handover.cancelBody: The receiver is told the handover was cancelled. You keep the lot and can hand it over again later.
handover.notSender: Only the organisation that started this handover can cancel it.
handover.expired: This handover expired before the receiver answered. Start it again if the lot is still leaving.

receiver.title: Handovers
receiver.sub: Lots arriving from other organisations, and lots you've sent.
receiver.emptyIncoming: No handovers are waiting for you. When another organisation hands a lot to you, it appears here to inspect and sign.
receiver.emptyOutgoing: Nothing is on its way from you.
receiver.receivedHelp: What you weighed on arrival. It is recorded with your signature.

outside.$template: Difference {n} {unit} ({pct}%) — outside the {tol}% tolerance. You can't accept this; reject it or raise a flag.

receiver.locationFailed: Your location isn't available. You can sign without it.

photosHelp.$template: Up to {max} photos: bags, seal, scale.

receiver.checklistNote: Answer each point from what you can see. The sender and a regulator read your answers if you reject.

meaning.$template: You confirm you received this lot from {sender}. The handover is complete once you sign.

next: You can hand it over or process it

rejectStays.$template: {sender} stays the holder. They can send the lot again with the right quantity.

partOf.$template: Split from {code}: the sender keeps the rest of that lot.

receiver.rejectReasonHelp: Pick one, or write your own. The sender and a regulator read it.
receiver.rejectNoteHelp: Optional detail for the sender and the regulator.
receiver.rejectFlag: Also raise a flag so a regulator looks at it

rejectedBody.$template: The lot stays with {sender} until it's resolved.

receiver.flagNote: A flag is open on this lot. It stays with its holder until a regulator clears it or confirms it as fraud.

transform.title: Transform lots
transform.sub: Processing that turns lots into new lots: washing, drying, milling, concentrating.
transform.stageHelp: The stage the new lots enter. It comes from the template of the lots you select.
transform.inputEmpty: Select the lots that go into this operation.
transform.noneHeld: You don't hold any active passports to process.

meterWithin.$template: Within limit · {below} below the allowed maximum

meterOver.$template: Over the allowed maximum by {over}. Lower the outputs to continue.

transform.blocked: Fix the mass balance to continue
transform.noYield: This stage has no maximum yield recorded; check the outputs by hand before signing.
transform.meaning: Your signature records this processing step. The input passports are closed and linked to the new ones.
transform.inputsClosed: The input passports are closed. The new ones are linked to them.

passportView.certificatesEmpty: No certificates are attached to this lot.
passportView.noGenealogy: This lot wasn't made from other lots, and hasn't been processed into any.
passportView.notHolder: Another organisation holds this lot. You can read its records but can't act on them.
passportView.openHandover: A handover of this lot is waiting for the receiver. It can be handed over again once that's answered.
passportView.retireBody: Retiring closes the lot: it can't be handed over or transformed again. Retire it when it reached its final buyer.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.sub: Signed documents you've issued, and those about your lots and facilities. Public verification pages show them.
certificates.notAllowedBody: Ask an admin of your organisation for access to passports.
certificates.empty: No certificates issued yet. Issue one to attach a signed document to a lot or a facility.
certificates.revokeBody: It shows as revoked on every public page that mentions it. The holder and their buyers can read your reason.
certificates.revokeReasonHelp: Shown to the holder and on the public page.
certificates.revokeReasonEmpty: Say why the certificate is being revoked.

new.title: Issue certificate
new.sub: Attach a signed document to a lot or a facility. It appears on public verification pages for that record.
new.passportEmpty: You don't hold any active passports.
new.typeHelp: Your organisation may issue the types it is accredited for.
new.typeEmpty: No certificate types yet. A platform admin accredits your organisation for the types you may issue.
new.validityHelp: The end date must be after the start date.
new.documentHelp: PDF, PNG or JPEG · up to 10 MB
new.checkAccredited: Your organisation is accredited for this type
new.checkDates: The validity window is in order
new.meaning: Your signature issues this certificate. Its document and dates can't be edited afterwards; a mistake is corrected by revoking it and issuing a new one.

flags.title: Flags and investigations
flags.empty: No flags. When something looks wrong with a lot — a record that changed, quantities that don't balance, a handover the receiver refused — a flag appears here.
flags.selectOne: Choose a flag to read it.
flags.clearBody: The lot can be handed over and processed again. Your note is shown to its holder.
flags.clearNoteEmpty: Say why the flag is cleared.
flags.fraudBodyNone: The flagged passport will be revoked, and everything made from it.
flags.fraudReasonHelp: What was confirmed. It is shown on the public pages of the affected lots.
flags.fraudWarning: Public verification pages for these lots will show Failed immediately. Holders and their buyers are notified.
flags.resolveNotYours: Only a regulator or the platform can resolve flags.
flags.raiseTitle: Raise a flag on this lot
flags.raiseBody: The lot stays with its current holder while the flag is open. A regulator reads your reason.
flags.raiseReasonHelp: Say what you saw, so a regulator knows where to look.
flags.resolveIntro: Read the lot's history before deciding. Clearing frees the lot; confirming fraud revokes it and everything made from it.
flags.affectedEmpty: Nothing else was made from this lot.

templates.title: Product templates
templates.sub: The platform's rules for one commodity: its unit, the stages a lot moves through, yields and evidence.

detail.name: Template name
detail.nameHelp: What this template is called, like Arabica coffee · cherry (Rwanda).
detail.commodityHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, like arabica_coffee_cherry.
detail.unitHelp: The unit every quantity in this template uses, like kg.
detail.capacityPerArea: Facility area × a rate per hectare per season
detail.originKindHelp: The kind of facility a lot may be issued at.
detail.stageKeyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, like washing_station.
detail.maxYieldHelp: On a transform, the outputs may be at most this share of the inputs. Leave empty for no limit.
detail.evidenceHelp: A valid certificate of each key must be attached before a lot may enter this stage.
detail.previewNote: A lot enters at the first stage and moves through them in order.
detail.notAllowedBody: Only the platform team edits product templates. Ask a platform admin if a template needs changing.

reports.title: Reports and audit
reports.sub: Every action on ChainTrack is written to a log that can't be edited.
reports.volumeEmpty: No volume recorded in this period.
reports.verifyChainHelp: Walks every recorded action and checks each row against the one before it. Platform only.
reports.verifyOk: Every row matches the one before it. The log is intact.

verifyBad.$template: The log doesn't match at row {seq}. Contact the platform team.

scanPage.title: Scan a passport
scanPage.hint: Point the camera at the QR label. The lot opens as soon as the code is read.

meta.landing: ChainTrack · Know where it came from
meta.landingDescription: Digital product passports for business shipments: verified origin, dual-signed handovers and a public verification anyone can scan.

auth.title: Every product has a story. Make it verifiable.
auth.body: Create trusted passports, sign custody handovers and protect your supply chain.
auth.foot: Secure by design · Built for regulated trade

signin.title: Sign in to your organisation
signin.sub: Use the email and password for your ChainTrack account.
signin.codeHelp: The 6 digits your authenticator app shows for ChainTrack.
signin.trustHelp: Skip the code on this device. Don't tick this on a shared computer.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: Enter your Email. We'll send a link that works for 30 minutes.
forgot.note: Resetting your password does not change your signing PIN or two-factor setup.

sent.$template: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.

nothing: Ask your organisation admin to send an invite.

reset.title: Choose a new password

rules.length: Use 8 to 72 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

reset.signOutNote: Every device signed in to your account will be signed out.
reset.expired: Reset links work once, for 30 minutes. Your password has not changed.
reset.done: You were signed out of every device. We've emailed you a confirmation with a link to lock your account if this wasn't you.

handoff.title: Switching organisation…
handoff.body: Opening your workspace at this address. You stay signed in.
handoff.failedTitle: You're not signed in here yet

lock.title: Lock your account?
lock.body: If you didn't change your password, lock the account now. Everyone signed in is signed out, and nobody can sign in until your organisation admin or ChainTrack support unlocks it.
lock.done: Nobody can sign in to it now. Contact your organisation admin or ChainTrack support to unlock it.
lock.expired: Lock links work once, for 7 days. Contact your organisation admin if you still need to lock the account.

signup.title: Create your organisation's account
signup.sub: You'll need your business registration and any operating licences. Verification takes about 2 working days.
signup.emailAvailable: This email can be used for the account.
signup.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or use another email.
signup.emailCheckFailed: We couldn't check this email just now. Try again before continuing.

passwordHelp.$template: Use {min} to {max} characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

signup.consent: I am authorised to register this organisation, and I agree that its documents will be checked.
signup.legalNameHelp: Exactly as on your registration certificate.
signup.slugHelp: Your team signs in at this name, in front of this site's address. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
signup.createdSub: Your organisation has its own address. Sign in there to upload your documents.

validation.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
validation.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords don't match. Type the same password twice.
validation.lotCode: Enter the lot code printed under the QR code.
validation.code: Enter the 6 digits shown in your authenticator app.
validation.passwordComplexity: Include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
validation.consent: Tick the box to confirm you may register this organisation.
validation.legalName: Enter the legal name, exactly as on your registration certificate.
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, like kitabi-washing.
validation.slugReserved: That address is reserved. Choose another.
validation.fileType: This file type can't be used. Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG.
validation.fileSize: This file is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller file or a lower-quality scan.
validation.reason: Say what is wrong, so the organisation knows what to fix.
validation.accreditationTypes: Choose at least one certificate type.
validation.dateOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.quantityPositive: Enter a whole number above zero.
validation.note: Say something, so the next person knows what happened.
validation.handoverStage: Choose the stage the lot goes into.
validation.facilityLocation: Drop a pin or draw the boundary on the map.
validation.licenceExpired: The licence must still be valid: choose a date after today.
validation.facilityKind: Choose what kind of facility this is.
validation.facilityKindKey: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores; start with a letter.
validation.facilityKindName: Enter a name for this facility kind.
validation.licence: Enter the licence number, as printed on the certificate.
validation.capacity: Enter the capacity, as a whole number above zero.
validation.capacityUnit: Enter the unit, like kg or bags.
validation.capacityPeriod: Choose the period the capacity is for.
validation.subjectId: Enter the lot code this certificate is for.
validation.outcome: Choose what happens to this flag.
validation.reasonRequired: Say why, so the record is complete.
validation.commodity: Enter the commodity, like coffee or cassava.
validation.unit: Enter the unit, like kg or bags.
validation.stages: Each template needs at least one stage.

pendingSub.$template: We're checking {name}. Most organisations are verified within 2 working days.

onboarding.uploadSub: Clear photos or PDFs. We check them against the national registry.
onboarding.notVerifiedYet: You can't issue or receive passports until verification is done.
onboarding.uploadAgain: Upload a corrected document below and it goes back to the reviewer.

progress.registryNote: We are checking your documents against the national registry.
progress.approvalNote: This page shows the outcome as soon as the review is done.

onboarding.licencesLater: Facility licences are added later, when you register each farm plot or site.

documents.choose: Tap to take a photo or choose a file
documents.hint: PDF, PNG or JPEG · up to 10 MB
documents.unreadable: This file can't be read as a PDF, PNG or JPEG. Choose another file.
documents.failed: The upload didn't finish. Nothing was saved. Try again.
documents.offline: The upload didn't finish. Nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again.

admin.title: Verification queue
admin.notAllowedBody: Only the platform's reviewers can open this page. Ask a platform admin if you need access.

empty.organisations: No organisations are waiting for review.
empty.issuers: No verified certifiers or regulators yet.
empty.approved: No organisations have been approved yet.
empty.rejected: No organisations have been rejected or asked for changes.

admin.selectOne: Choose an organisation from the list to review it.
admin.noDocuments: No documents uploaded yet. It can't be approved until it has at least one.

review.title: Decision
review.noteHelp: Required to reject or ask for changes. The organisation sees it.

accreditation.title: Accreditation
accreditation.sub: Choose which certificates this organisation may issue, and for how long.
accreditation.noTypes: No templates ask for any evidence yet, so there are no certificate types to choose.
accreditation.notice: Accreditation is shown with every certificate they issue. Ending it doesn't cancel certificates they already issued.

help.title: How verification works
help.body: Every time this page opens, ChainTrack compares each signed business record with the copy sealed when it was signed. A signed record can't be edited afterwards.

route.label: Drawing of the lot's route, from its origin to its current holder

verification.notFoundTitle: We can't find this lot code
verification.notFoundBody: Check the code on the label and scan it again. If the label is damaged, ask the holder for the lot code.
verification.errorTitle: We couldn't check this lot just now
verification.errorBody: The records could not be reached. Nothing about the lot has changed. Try again in a moment.

alert.lead: Do not accept, pay for or ship this lot.
alert.rest: One or more of its records failed verification. The reasons are listed below.

verification.technicalIntro: When a record is signed, its fingerprint is sealed on a public ledger (a blockchain), where it cannot be changed. We compare each record with its sealed fingerprint every time this page is opened.
verification.noCertificates: No certificates are attached to this lot or its origin.
verification.footer: ChainTrack product passport · The page reflects records sealed up to the time of your scan.

record_intact.label: Records unchanged since signing
record_intact.pass: Every passport in this lot's history reads exactly as it did when it was signed.

anchored.label: Records match their sealed copies
anchored.pass: Each record, its holder and its quantity match the copy sealed when it was signed.

origin.label: Origin is registered and licensed
origin.pass: Every branch of this lot's history ends at a registered facility owned by a verified organisation.

capacity.label: Within declared capacity
capacity.pass: No more was issued from the origin than its declared capacity for the period.

mass_balance.label: Quantities balance
mass_balance.pass: At every processing step, what came out is no more than the inputs could yield.

certificates.label: Certificates valid
certificates.pass: Every certificate is in date, unrevoked, from an accredited issuer, and unchanged since it was issued.

status.label: No open concerns or revocations
status.pass: Nothing in this lot's history has been revoked or is being looked into.

summary.verified: Every record in its history matches the copy sealed when it was signed, and nothing has changed since.

warning.$template: Its records are intact, but {points} attention. Read them before you rely on this passport.

summary.failed: This passport failed verification. Do not rely on it until the points below are resolved.

expired.$template: Expired {when}. Ask the holder for a current one before you rely on it.
